# xyops_servers (Data Source)

Searches xyOps server records with search_servers. Unlike the live registry, the matches include servers that are offline or were dropped from the registry, so references stay stable between refreshes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xyops_servers" "all" {
  # Defaults to all records the instance kept (including offline servers).
  # Examples: groups:main, os_distro:ubuntu, os_arch:x86_64
  query = "*"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of rows to return. Defaults to 100.
- `offset` (Number) Zero-based row offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.
- `query` (String) Search query in the xyOps index syntax, e.g. `groups:main`, `os_distro:ubuntu`, `os_arch:x86_64`. Defaults to all records.

### Read-Only

- `servers` (List of Object) Matching server records without info, in the order xyOps returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))
- `total` (Number) Total number of matching records, without pagination.

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `auto_group` (Boolean)
- `created` (Number)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
